blocks.text: RMA Studio Academy is proud to announce its highly anticipated 4th Grand Annual Concert, themed “Destination: The World Stage,” taking place on November 5, 2026, at the prestigious Proscenium Theater in Makati City. Designed as an immersive musical experience, this year’s production promises an elevated celebration of music, excellence, and refined creativity. Moving beyond a standard showcase, “Destination: The World Stage” curated by RMA Studio Academy brings together talented students, high-profile celebrity performers, families, corporate leaders, and distinguished guests.
